channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicação da lei da dosimetria até julgamento do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the dosimetry law that reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, pending the Court's ruling on its validity. The decision responds to defense requests from convicted individuals, including a lawyer sentenced to 16 years, citing legal security amid challenges to the law. The law was promulgated this Friday after Congress overturned the presidential veto, but remains subject to judicial review.

item.title: Lula não deveria ter jogado gasolina na fogueira do caso Enel, diz especialista
item.description: President Lula used Enel as a scapegoat in his speech, according to Adriano Pires of CBIE, which further politicized the energy crisis. The expert criticized the approach as inflammatory and inappropriate for addressing the structural issue.

item.title: Moraes suspende aplicação da Lei da Dosimetria até que o STF analise ações que questionam a norma
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law until the STF rules on the constitutionality challenges. The measure affects those convicted of the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, who awaits a decision on sentence reduction. So far, Moraes has applied this suspension in at least ten penal executions.

item.title: Hélio Lopes aciona CBF para pedir convocação de Neymar para a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Federal Deputy Hélio Lopes (PL), an ally of Jair Bolsonaro, sent an official letter to the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) requesting Neymar's call-up for the 2026 World Cup, citing his record as Brazil's all-time top scorer and his role as a unifying national symbol. Despite not being selected since 2023 and limited playing time at Santos in 2026 (12 appearances, 5 goals), Lopes argued the request reflects the wishes of millions of Brazilians, emphasizing it does not seek technical interference with the coaching staff's decisions.

item.title: Reunião com Trump reduz desgaste de Lula nas redes, diz Bites
item.description: Lula's meeting with Trump and the PF operation targeting Ciro Nogueira reduced negative social media mentions, but his image remains unfavorable. Negative mentions dropped from 54.6% to 43.6% between April 29 and May 7, as allies seek to counter narratives of congressional weakness. The term 'BolsoMaster' was used by supporters to link investigations to Flávio Bolsonaro's network.

item.title: Investigação das fraudes no INSS tem uma boa e uma má notícia para Lula
item.description: So far, INSS whistleblower testimonies do not personally implicate President Lula in the fraud scheme that stole over R$ 6 billion from retirees, but they do implicate his longtime allies and his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha). The plea deal with businessman Maurício Camisotti, described as the scheme’s business arm, was initially agreed upon by the PF but paused to involve the PGR, indicating institutional coordination. The restart of Camisotti’s testimony is seen as a positive sign of investigative unity, even though it does not reach the president directly.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio vai a lançamento de pré-candidaturas do PL em SC
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attends the launch of the pre-candidacies of Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-SC) and Carol De Toni (PL-SC) for the Federal Senate in Florianópolis at the Music Park complex in Jurerê. The event also formalizes Jorginho Mello (PL) as the pre-candidate for re-election as governor of Santa Catarina, with live streaming on the PL Santa Catarina profile. The schedule includes meetings with business leaders and institutional visits, featuring participation from state and national party leaders such as Senator Jorge Seif (PL-SC).

item.title: Vice de Nunes recomenda uso de Ypê, mesmo após alerta de Vigilância de SP e proibição da Anvisa
item.description: São Paulo's vice mayor, Ricardo Mello Araújo (PL), publicly defended the use of Ypê products despite health warnings from Anvisa and São Paulo's State Health Surveillance due to microbial contamination in certain batches. He accused authorities of unfairly targeting the company, aligning with narratives of political persecution against Bolsonaro supporters. Ypê had donated to the PL campaign in 2022, and Araújo was recently passed over by the party for a Senate spot in São Paulo.

item.title: O jantar de cinco horas para Flávio Bolsonaro em Miami
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a five-hour dinner in Miami hosted by Marcelo Kayath, attended by around 20 Brazilians, mostly from the financial sector and former corporate executives, including Eduardo Bartolomeo, former CEO of Vale. The gathering highlighted ties between Bolsonaro’s circle and Brazilian economic elites residing abroad, particularly in Miami. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Centrão barrou Messias para impedir investigações sobre Vorcaro, diz PT
item.description: PT congressional leader Pedro Uczai claims the rejection of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court was part of a congressional 'big deal' to block investigations into businessman Daniel Vorcaro and reduce sentences for those involved in the January 8 attacks. He alleges the maneuver involved Ciro Nogueira, Davi Alcolumbre, and Flávio Bolsonaro to weaken the January 8 CPMI and prevent an investigative ally from joining the STF.

item.title: Lula vê em Trump seu maior aliado contra ações hostis da Casa Branca
item.description: Lula’s team brought paper documents to a meeting with Trump in Washington to avoid hostile actions from the White House. The Brazilian president views Trump as a strategic ally against U.S. pressures. The move reflects concerns over bilateral relations amid potential protectionist or interventionist measures from the United States.

item.title: Alvo da PF, Ciro Nogueira passa a ser renegado pelo bolsonarismo
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), targeted in a Federal Police operation for allegedly using his mandate to serve the interests of banker Daniel Vorcaro (owner of Master), has been renounced by Bolsonaro allies, who now describe him as merely a 'circumstantial ally' and recall his past closeness to Lula. Despite being considered as a potential running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro and having served as Chief of Staff in Bolsonaro's government, his reputation has been damaged by corruption allegations.

item.title: Lacunas na proposta de delação de Vorcaro
item.description: Investigators consider Daniel Vorcaro’s plea bargain proposal selective and insufficient, as he appears to be protecting allies by naming only certain targets, such as Senator Ciro Nogueira. STF ministers state the plea deal will only be valid if full restitution of involved funds is made, rejecting partial negotiations. Meanwhile, the STF advances measures against judiciary benefits ('penduricalhos'), and the TSE faces the challenge of countering 'synthetic fakes' on social media with electoral intent.

item.title: Estratégia do PL no Rio será colocar Eduardo Paes ‘no colo de Lula’
item.description: The PL's strategy in Rio de Janeiro is to link Eduardo Paes' (PSD) image with President Lula to exploit the latter's unpopularity in the state, where Bolsonaro won in both 2018 and 2022. Although Paes leads in polls with 34%, the PL seeks to undermine his proximity to Lula, while Paes aims to broaden his support by selecting evangelical Jane Reis (MDB) as his running mate, sister of a Bolsonaro ally.

item.title: Defesa de Débora do Batom pede revisão da pena ao STF
item.description: The defense of Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do batom', filed a petition with the STF to review her 14-year prison sentence for the January 8 attacks, citing the new Dosimetry Law. The defense argues the law reduces penalties for participants in a 'crowd context' without leadership and requests the maximum 2/3 sentence reduction, seeking immediate release.

item.title: Novo lança André Marinho ao governo do Rio em evento com Zema
item.description: The Novo party launched the pre-candidacy of comedian and communicator André Marinho for the Rio de Janeiro state government at an event held on Saturday, the 9th. The launch featured the presence of former Minas Gerais governor and presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema, also from Novo. Marinho, son of businessman Paulo Marinho, is set to face former mayor Eduardo Paes and other contenders in the state race.

item.title: Com a presença de Zema, Novo lança aliado de família Bolsonaro ao governo do Rio
item.description: The Novo party launched the pré-candidacy of André Marinho, a 31-year-old communicator and son of Bolsonaro ally Paulo Marinho, for governor of Rio de Janeiro. The event featured Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pré-candidate for president, who emphasized opposition to the state's political system. Marinho frames Eduardo Paes and Douglas Ruas as direct adversaries, aiming to unite evangelicals, military, anti-PT, and Lava Jato supporters in a campaign of outrage against the left and 'Alerj's bloodsuckers'.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra disputa Lula x Flávio a menos de cinco meses da eleição
item.description: Genial/Quaest released a new presidential poll for 2026 with 2,004 face-to-face interviews, a 2-percentage-point margin of error, and 95% confidence level. The survey focuses on the Lula (PT) vs. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) race, following recent polls showing a technical tie or slight edge for the senator, while Lula retains strength in the Northeast but faces wear in urban and Southeastern areas. The poll may reveal whether Bolsonaro’s growth is solidifying, whether Lula has stabilized his support, and what space remains for alternative candidates in the PT-Bolsonaro polarization.

item.title: O que muda com Lei da Dosimetria para Bolsonaro e outros condenados por golpe
item.description: The promulgation of the Dosimetry Law allows those convicted in the January 8, 2023, coup attempt to request sentence reductions and regime progression in the STF. The law unifies penalties for coup d'État and abolition of the Democratic State of Law, easing transition to semi-open or open regimes. Former President Jair Bolsonaro is cited as a potential beneficiary, possibly enabling him to serve sentence before the 2030 elections.

item.title: O zumbi Lula perambula
item.description: The meeting between Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and former U.S. President Donald Trump sparked speculation about Lula's political vitality, with some suggesting the encounter created an impression of an 'active' government, despite being largely symbolic and occurring amid complex geopolitical dynamics, particularly involving China. The image of Lula's supporters excited by the visit contrasts with uncertainties about the meeting's real diplomatic impact.

item.title: Operação contra Ciro Nogueira e disputa no Senado antecipam embate de Lula e Flávio sobre o Master
item.description: The Federal Police operation targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) and the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF precede the political clash between President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) over the Master case, highlighting tensions around judicial influence and party alliances.

item.title: MPF arquiva mais uma investigação contra Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police (MPF) archived an investigation against Jair Bolsonaro for alleged intimidation of the Supreme Court during an April 2025 protest, ruling the demonstration peaceful, lawful, and without evidence of crime. The MPF concluded there was no basis for criminal prosecution, as Bolsonaro’s conduct was defensive and aimed at achieving a political solution through Congress.

item.title: Após atrito com Gilmar, Zema ganhou 1,4 mi de seguidores nas redes
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate of the Novo party for the presidency, gained 1.4 million social media followers in April 2026 following a public clash with Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes, who requested an investigation into Zema over a video titled 'The Untouchables'. His total following rose by 32% to 6.0 million, with Instagram alone growing 36.5% (932.7 thousand new followers). Zema responded by accusing the STF of persecution and stating that those who consider themselves 'untouchable' do not tolerate jokes.

item.title: Jovens mudam perfil e redesenham disputa eleitoral
item.description: Recent polls show that young voters aged 16 to 24 are increasingly favoring Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), with varying leads across institutes but a clear trend of declining PT support among this historically left-leaning demographic. While Lula maintains a slight edge in some surveys (e.g., Datafolha), others show Bolsonaro ahead, particularly among 25-34-year-olds. The Lula government has responded with Desenrola 2.0, targeting student debt relief via the Fies, while Bolsonaro strengthens his appeal through short, viral social media content aligned with digital algorithms.

item.title: Flávio monta time de campanha com Marinho na cabeça e 4 subdivisões
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has structured his presidential pre-campaign with Rogério Marinho as central political coordinator, dividing the team into four strategic fronts: government program (Eduardo Cury), legal (Maria Claudia Bucchianeri), infrastructure (Vicente Santini), and communication (Marcelo Lopes). The campaign has established 22 state-level platforms in six months, surpassing Lula and Bolsonaro’s performance at the same stage in 2022 and 2026, while keeping the government program content under strategic reserve.

item.title: Psol-Rede aciona STF contra lei da Dosimetria
item.description: The Psol-Rede federation and the Brazilian Press Association filed ADIs 7966 and 7967 at the STF against the Dosimetria Law (15.402/2026), which modifies sentence progression and remission rules for crimes against the democratic state. The plaintiffs claim the law creates lenient treatment for January 8 rioters, violates the constitutional principle of individualized punishment, and suffered procedural flaws, including partial overturning of an integral presidential veto and Senate amendments without returning the bill to the Chamber.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: o que mostram Meio/Ideia e Real Time sobre disputa Lula x Flávio
item.description: The Meio/Ideia and Real Time Big Data polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential 2026 presidential election runoff, with Lula leading in first-round scenarios. Despite the PT’s advantage in first-round simulations, direct second-round matchups reveal tight races, underscoring ongoing political polarization.

item.title: Moraes é sorteado relator de ações que questionam Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes was appointed rapporteur at the STF for two actions challenging the Dosimetry Law, passed by Congress after overturning a presidential veto. The law allows sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8 acts and may benefit Jair Bolsonaro. Moraes set deadlines for the Presidency, Congress, PGR, and AGU to submit information and opinions.

item.title: Márcio Coimbra na Crusoé: Diplomacia de urgência
item.description: President Lula's visit to the United States, despite tensions with Venezuela and Iran, shows that Brazilian diplomacy prioritizes political urgency over ideological affinities. According to Márcio Coimbra in Crusoé, the meeting was delayed due to geopolitical conflicts but ultimately occurred as an immediate strategic necessity. The comparison to a chess game played during an earthquake illustrates the volatility of the international landscape in which Brazil operates.

item.title: Flávio fala em dar cargo a Jair Bolsonaro caso vença eleição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated that if elected president in October, he may invite his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, to join his government. He said Jair Bolsonaro will continue to serve as his political 'compass' and could hold a position in the Planalto if he wishes. The remarks were made in an interview with CNN Brasil on Friday, the 8th.

item.title: Vamos comparar o Brasil de Lula e de Bolsonaro, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: Edinho Silva, president of the Workers' Party, said Lula’s re-election campaign will compare the current government with Bolsonaro’s administration, highlighting infrastructure and popular housing projects under Lula. He stated that the Bolsonaro family opposes such comparisons and that PT alliances will be broader than in 2022, with 90% of the campaign already organized across states.

item.title: Vendida por Tarcísio, Sabesp vê alta de queixas do povo e lucros de donos
item.description: Privatized in 2022 by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, Sabesp has seen a rise in public complaints about water and sewage service quality, while shareholders and controllers celebrate profit growth. The contradiction between deteriorating service for citizens and financial gains for owners intensifies debate over the effects of privatizing essential services.

item.title: Moraes manda Planalto e Congresso se manifestarem sobre Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has ordered the Presidency and the National Congress to submit their positions on the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences for those convicted of coup d'état. The ruling aims to clarify the limits of the law's application in cases of attacks against the Democratic Rule of Law.

item.title: Precisamos de uma reforma político-eleitoral, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: Edinho Silva, president of the Workers' Party (PT), urged for an immediate political-electoral reform, stating that Brazil's political model is broken and no longer satisfies society. He criticized Congress for seizing the public budget and weakening the Executive, blocking Jorge Messias' Supreme Court nomination, and called for judicial reform to bring the Judiciary closer to the people and make it a defender of democracy.

item.title: Após décadas de exílio, fóssil de réptil gigante vai voltar ao Ceará
item.description: The fossilized skull of the predator Irritator challengeri, illegally extracted from Brazil's Araripe Basin in 1991 and taken to Germany, will be repatriated following an agreement between Lula and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The skull, which had been fraudulently altered with plaster and automotive putty to inflate its black-market value, will be displayed at the Plácido Cidade Nuvens Paleontology Museum in Santana do Cariri, Ceará.

item.title: Moraes cobra manifestação de Lula e Alcolumbre sobre Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has ordered the Presidency and Congress to provide information on the Dosimetry Law within five days, following legal challenges to its validity. The ruling requires input from the Attorney General’s Office and the Prosecutor General’s Office. The case implicates President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre as the heads of the respective institutions.

item.title: O fim precoce do pacto de não agressão entre Ciro Nogueira e Lula
item.description: Police Federal investigations into Senator Ciro Nogueira, identified as the 'political arm' of Daniel Vorcaro and tied to Bolsonarism, are benefiting President Lula by weakening a key Centrão leader aligned with the right. The tacit non-aggression pact between Nogueira and Lula has collapsed under judicial pressure.

item.title: Em ano eleitoral, pacote de bondades de Lula já soma R$ 144 bilhões
item.description: President Lula’s government announced an economic benefits package totaling R$ 143.7 billion for 2026, amid the electoral calendar and rising poll numbers for opposition pre-candidate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The largest share, approximately R$ 76.2 billion, is directed toward income and consumption support measures aimed at bolstering the government’s electoral base. The move is widely interpreted as a preemptive fiscal strategy to influence the upcoming election.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira virou assombração: Flávio Bolsonaro já benze o gabinete
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro distanced himself from Ciro Nogueira amid the Banco Master corruption scandal, dismissing the ally as a mere 'courtesy' to protect his own image. While Ciro faces asset seizures and reduced allowance, Bolsonarism seeks new allies, praising figures like André Mendonça to distance itself from the scandal. The episode reveals the Bolsonaro clan’s pattern of political disposal, leaving allies damaged while Lula gains international stature.

item.title: Wilson Pedroso na Crusoé: Fique longe, Trump
item.description: Lula's visit to Brasília aims to counter the influence of Trumpism in Brazil's 2026 elections, particularly through actions involving Eduardo Bolsonaro. The government seeks to prevent the 2026 race from becoming a prime target for the radical right inspired by Donald Trump.

item.title: Oposição ressuscista debate da maioridade penal para bombar Flávio
item.description: Bolsonarist leaders, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, revived the debate on reducing the age of criminal responsibility as a strategy to boost his 2026 presidential pre-campaign, citing a São Paulo gang rape case involving minors as justification. PL deputies delivered fiery speeches in Congress supporting the measure, and Flávio stated that if elected, he will ensure its approval in the National Congress.

item.title: Pacheco espera Alcolumbre para decidir se atende apelo de Lula por MG
item.description: Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) has not yet formalized his pre-candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais, waiting for a political clarification with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), whose relationship with President Lula directly affects his decision. Pacheco’s hesitation reflects the delicate balance between party alliances and federal government pressure for him to run in the state.

item.title: Jones Manoel critica acordo de Lula com EUA: 'Trump vai fortalecer Flávio'
item.description: Historian and federal deputy pre-candidate Jones Manoel (PSOL-PE) criticized President Lula's agreement with the Donald Trump administration, calling the strategy misguided in attempting to neutralize potential U.S. interference in Brazil's elections. He argued that such rapprochement could strengthen figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, suggesting that engaging with Trump poses risks to the sovereignty of Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro oficializa palanque em SC após racha provocado por Carlos
item.description: The PL officially launched its pre-candidacies in Santa Catarina today following the turmoil caused by Carlos Bolsonaro in the state. Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for President of the Republic and Carlos’s brother, is participating in the event as a central figure of the platform. The move aims to strengthen the Bolsonarist base in SC after internal divisions.

item.title: O senador que faz ponte de Alcolumbre com Lula após derrota de Messias
item.description: Following the defeat of Jorge Messias in his bid for a Supreme Court seat, Senator Otto Alencar (PSD-BA), president of the Senate’s Constitution and Justice Committee, is mediating talks between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) to ease tensions between the Executive and Legislative branches. Alencar advocates for a 'cooling down' approach, stressing that the government needs Senate support to pass key agendas like the security PEC and the end of the 6×1 work scale. The effort aims to restore institutional dialogue after the historic rejection of Lula’s nominee.

item.title: Filiações: enquanto o PT segue no 'vermelho' em 2026, PL ganha mais de 50 mil
item.description: The PT will end April with 1.668 million members, failing to recover losses since the start of 2026, indicating party stagnation less than 150 days before the elections. Meanwhile, the PL, led by Flávio Bolsonaro, gained over 50,000 new members in 2026, reaching 947,503 militants, reflecting significant growth of the right-wing party.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, sábado, 9 de maio: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: On Saturday, May 9, 2026, Brazilian sports fans will enjoy a packed football schedule, featuring live matches from international leagues such as the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Turkish Super Lig, and domestic competitions including Brasileirão Série A and Série B. Key international fixtures include Liverpool vs Chelsea at 8:30 AM and Manchester City vs Brentford at 1:30 PM in the Premier League, alongside notable matches in Germany, Italy, Turkey, and Spain. In Brazil, Série A will feature Coritiba vs Internacional, Fluminense vs Vitória, and Bahia vs Cruzeiro, while Série B includes the Goiás vs Vila Nova derby and matches like Ponte Preta vs Sport and Ceará vs Atlético Goianiense.

item.title: Governo muda rota e deixa PEC da Segurança em 2º plano; entenda
item.description: The Lula government has decided to delay the processing of the Public Security PEC in Congress, after its approval in the Chamber, due to the lack of urgency from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and a strategy to avoid polarizing topics in an election year. Priority is now given to more urgent proposals, such as reducing fuel taxes and ending the 6×1 work scale.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro busca se distanciar de Ciro Nogueira sem ferir aliança com União-PP e tenta colar Master no PT
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is attempting to distance himself from Senator Ciro Nogueira, president of the PP, following a Federal Police operation targeting Nogueira over the Banco Master scandal, which revealed alleged 'political shielding'. While seeking to preserve his alliance with União-PP, he is also trying to link the scandal to the PT to damage the opposition. The move reflects an effort to safeguard his political capital amid growing legal and reputational risks.

item.title: Bondades do governo Lula já somam R$ 144 bilhões em ano eleitoral
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s government announced 11 measures totaling R$ 143.7 billion in spending this election year, sparking debate among experts about the best use of these resources for the country. The funds are tied to social programs, infrastructure, and sectoral support, raising questions about their electoral impact and fiscal sustainability.
